description: This Java source file defines a Spring configuration class 'CorsConfig' that sets up Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) rules for a web application. It provides a method to configure allowed origins dynamically via an environment variable, and specifies permitted HTTP methods and headers for cross-origin requests.

classes.name: CorsConfig
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that sets up CORS policies for the application, allowing dynamic configuration of allowed origins through environment variables.

methods.name: corsConfigurer
methods.description: Defines a WebMvcConfigurer bean that configures CORS settings, including allowed origins (from environment variable or default), allowed HTTP methods, headers, and credentials settings.
